observed_text: If the metal film is driven above its plasma / interband edge it becomes transmitting and the Kretschmann (or grating) reflectance dip should disappear in that same spectral window.
implied_text: The interface-bound mode is the same electron population as the bulk mirror. Clock overrun that kills R also kills SPR.
description: A film that has gone plasma-transparent cannot host an SPR dip at that frequency.
notes: Conjecture from collective-screening. Extracted SPR rows locate the thickness window not this spectral twin.

observed_text: A percolated island metal film that is already transmitting in the visible should not produce a propagating-mode Kretschmann dip even if the nominal mass-thickness is tens of nanometres.
implied_text: No connected screening buffer ⇒ no interface-bound collective mode. Localized particle plasmons if any are a different artifact.
description: Island films that starve the mirror also starve Kretschmann SPR.
notes: Pairs with reflection thin-film / percolation. Localized Mie plasmons are not this prediction.

observed_text: Lowering the free-electron density until the optical plasma edge drops through the visible should also inflate the RF skin depth in the same sample.
implied_text: Optical R and RF δ are two clocks on one carrier density. Starve n and both envelopes move together.
description: One n moves the optical edge and the classical skin depth together.
value_text: same n for R(ω) and δ(ω)
notes: Does not claim optical penetration equals √(2/ωμσ). Only that they share n.

observed_text: Magneto-optical Faraday rotation through a metal or doped plasma should collapse in the same spectral window where that medium goes plasma-transparent.
implied_text: No collective screening population left to split n±.
description: Faraday in a free-electron medium dies with the plasma edge.
notes: Supporting readout not a core spec. Low confidence: interband Faraday in insulators is a different channel.

observed_text: An FM grain already below the KV thermal-escape line should not hold a static Hex loop shift even if an AFM pin is present.
implied_text: The pin writes a latch cell. If the cell is superparamagnetic there is nothing to pin on laboratory time.
description: Exchange-bias requires a thermally stable FM latch cell.
notes: Conjecture from anisotropy-latch onto the pin. NdFeB ~30 nm is the parent number not a bilayer measurement.

observed_text: A superparamagnetic grain should show no static saturation magnetostriction on laboratory time. Any λ would average toward zero with M.
implied_text: Static ΔL is locked to a held M. No held M ⇒ no static λs.
description: The strain channel dies with the latch cell.
notes: Dynamic / RMS magnetostriction is not this claim.

observed_text: A ferroelectric film thinner than its depolarization / dead-layer envelope should lose usable remnant P even when T < Tc and the polar phase is still named.
implied_text: The polar latch needs a volume that can stand the depolarization field. Below that the well is emptied.
description: Superparaelectric / depolarization collapse of Pr in thin films.
notes: Ec / depolarization are already an open mesoscale gap. This is the design talking before the number exists.

observed_text: A superconducting wire or constriction narrower than the coherence length should not hold a well-defined trapped fluxoid n Φ0.
implied_text: The phase winding needs a condensate cross-section of order ξ. Starve that buffer and the integer is not a stable output.
description: Fluxoid hardware includes a ξ-class cross-section not just a closed loop.
notes: ξ is a material class (nm to μm). Conjecture from gapped-condensate.

observed_text: The AC Josephson lock should wash out once the drive frequency is no longer small compared with the gap frequency 2Δ/h of the electrodes.
implied_text: The weak-link clock rides on the parent condensate. Overrun the gap clock and the lock is no longer a dissipationless pair current.
description: V–ν lock is not available above the gap frequency class.
notes: Gap frequency is ~10^11 Hz in conventional metals. High-frequency pair breaking is the guessed collapse.

observed_text: A type-II loop with mobile vortices should not hold a laboratory-timescale persistent current even though T < Tc and H < Hc2.
implied_text: R=0 after Hc1 is a pinning resource. Unpin the lattice and the persistent current decays by flux flow.
description: Persistent current requires pinned vortices in the mixed state.
notes: Unpacks pinning-after-hc1 onto the persistent-current output.

observed_text: A dilute alkali BEC should not produce a thermomechanical fountain or a superleak viscosity collapse of the He-4 kind.
implied_text: Fountain / superleak need a dense two-fluid ρs. Phase-space condensation is not that hardware.
description: Dilute BEC is not chargeless-superflow in disguise.
notes: Conjecture from chargeless-superflow downward.

observed_text: A given crystal face with a given contamination state should show the same φ in photoemission threshold and in the Richardson plot to within the usual tenths-of-an-eV face scatter.
implied_text: One surface gate opened by hν or by heat. If the two φ disagree beyond face scatter the shared-gate design is in tension.
description: Photoelectric and thermionic φ on the same face are one number.
notes: Library already says they share a class. This row conjectures a same-sample identity.

observed_text: In the same crystal the photocurrent onset and the optical absorption edge should sit at the same Eg except for known exciton / Urbach tails.
implied_text: One gate read two ways. A large split is a different machine or a trap channel.
description: Photoconductive onset tracks the absorption edge.
value_text: same Eg (Si 1.12 eV as the pin)
notes: Close to extracted shared-Eg consistency; kept as a same-sample prediction.

observed_text: Approaching Tm (or a displacive structural transition) a zone-center or zone-boundary branch should soften before Bragg order is lost.
implied_text: The grid’s allowed-clock table fails by mode softening not only by a sudden Tm jump.
description: Softening is a predicted precursor of grid loss. Not required at every melting point.
value_text: ω → 0 on some branch as T → Tm
notes: Many melts are first-order and skip a clean soft mode. Flagged low on purpose.

observed_text: Phonon thermal conductivity of the crystal should collapse or change discontinuously at Tm when the grid stops being a grid.
implied_text: No crystalline mfp resource ⇒ no crystal κ. Liquid heat transport is a different channel.
description: Crystal phonon κ does not survive melting.
notes: Obvious once the grid is one machine. Still a design-down claim not a library sentence.

observed_text: The shear speed should vanish at melting while a longitudinal liquid speed remains.
implied_text: G → 0 is the elastic face of grid loss. No shear in a liquid is already extracted; this row pins that collapse to Tm.
description: Shear sound dies with the grid at Tm.
notes: Tightest of the grid-down conjectures.

observed_text: A closed few-spin or few-mode system should not yield a stable thermometer reading independent of the observation window.
implied_text: The average is not a law below a statistical buffer. No universal N; the prediction is the failure class not a number.
description: Few independent contributors ⇒ no stable T.
notes: Restates the family gap as a concrete negative experiment.

observed_text: A Poisson shot-noise floor that survives T → 0 at finite current is not the Nyquist / Brownian thermal average.
implied_text: Shot noise is a count-of-events machine. Johnson–Nyquist is an ensemble average. Collapsing one should not be sold as collapsing the other.
description: Shot noise is a different machine and is not yet in the library.
notes: No effect file. effect_slug left null on purpose. Candidate tenth-adjacent artifact not a new design yet.

observed_text: Above TB but still below the FM Tc the loop shift Hex should be gone while ordinary FM remanence remains.
implied_text: The pin has thermally unlocked. The parent latch is still written. That split is the reason this is its own machine.
description: Hex dies at TB; Mr of the FM can survive.
notes: This is the design talking. Library already leans this way; the row makes the split an atomic prediction.

observed_text: The same FM film without an AFM pin (or after the pin is destroyed) should show an unshifted loop with Hex ≈ 0.
implied_text: Hex is not a property of the FM latch. Remove the second latch and the shift goes.
description: No pin ⇒ no loop shift.
notes: Downward claim from exchange-pin onto the FM hysteresis file.

observed_text: χ = C/T cannot be used as the energy barrier of a permanent-magnet latch. The unlocked ensemble is the population the latch replaces.
implied_text: If a mapping treats Curie χ as the latch barrier the anisotropy-latch design is in tension.
description: Unlocked χ is incompatible with a held directional state.
notes: Pairs with the extracted unlocked-no-latch row. Kept as a named downward exclusion.

observed_text: On a given metal φ and the optical plasma / interband edge must not be required to coincide. A sample can sit below φ and below ωp (mirror no photoemission) or in other combinations.
implied_text: Two gates on one surface. Identifying them collapses two designs into one number.
description: φ is not ωp.
value_text: φ ≠ ωp (Ag ~4.3 eV vs ~3.9 eV edge)
notes: Library already warns. This row is the screening engine forbidding the identification.

observed_text: Integer QHE plateaus should not be readable as a superconducting pairing gap or as a Meissner expulsion. The hardware is a 2DEG plus Landau levels plus an edge channel.
implied_text: If this claim is forced into gapped-condensate the design is over-stretched. Leave QHE unmapped as a member until it owns its own machine.
description: QHE is not the charged pairing condensate.
notes: Why QHE stayed off implication_design. Predicted as an incompatibility not as a tenth design.

observed_text: Liquid 4He below Tλ should not expel magnetic field or show χ = −1 of the Meissner kind.
implied_text: No charge ⇒ no London λ ⇒ no electromagnetic expulsion. Circulation is not screening.
description: Chargeless superflow does not do Meissner.
notes: Downward from chargeless-superflow. A charged-superfluid analog would be a different machine.

observed_text: A muon-free hydride cell (Pd–D or Ni–H pulsed coil with no muon source) should not emit the μCF cycle: no ~100–150 dt fusions per stopped muon and no catalysis that dies with τμ or sticking.
implied_text: This gate requires the muon node. Lattice strain and defect inventory are not substitutes. Cosmic-ray flux does not track bake-out or cold work.
description: A muon-free cell is not this machine.
notes: Downward from energy-gate. Bounds EM-LENR: isolate the latch; do not file that cell as μCF.

observed_text: A ballistic 1D constriction gated without a perpendicular field should show 2e²/h steps (or pinch-off) and should not produce a Hall plateau at RK/ν with Rxx→0 of the integer-QHE kind.
implied_text: Edge-channel hardware is a gapped 2D bulk plus an edge path. A QPC has no bulk Landau gap and needs no B.
description: QPC is not the edge-channel machine.
notes: Downward from edge-channel. Library already states the split; this row makes it a design commitment.

observed_text: A 2D topological-insulator helical edge (QSHE) or a magnetically gapped Chern-insulator edge (QAHE) that shows a quantized conductance plateau without a perpendicular-field Landau ladder would share the edge-path stack but not the integer-QHE clock. Either should be added as a second core member of edge-channel rather than forced into integer QHE or into QPC.
implied_text: If this cousin is folded into the integer-QHE B-opened ladder the design is over-stretched. File it first; then promote edge-channel from draft.
description: QSHE / QAHE are cousins not yet in the library.
value_text: helical or Chern edge; no Landau ladder
notes: effect_slug left null on purpose. Upgrade trigger for formal status. Do not mint a second predicted cousin row.

observed_text: If the trap and cooling are switched off while T and n are still nominally below the last recorded Tc(n), the bimodal peak and interference contrast should vanish as the cloud expands.
implied_text: Holding the dilute condensate needs continuous trap plus cool. Dark hold is not this machine.
description: Trap off ⇒ laboratory condensate is gone.
notes: Downward from phase-space-condensate. Atomic form of not-zero-hold-power. File already notes expansion after release; this row is the hold-power test.

observed_text: A dilute alkali BEC should not expel magnetic field or show χ = −1 of the Meissner kind, and it should not present a London λ.
implied_text: Phase-space condensation is chargeless and has no pairing condensate. Circulation or vortices in the cloud are not electromagnetic screening.
description: Dilute BEC is not a London superconductor.
notes: Twin of predicted:meissner:no-expulsion-in-he4 from the dilute-cloud side.

observed_text: Tλ at saturated vapour pressure should stay 2.17 K and should not track n^{2/3} of a dilute trapped cloud. Changing the density of an alkali BEC is not a prediction for the helium λ-line.
implied_text: Dense two-fluid He-4 and dilute phase-space condensation share a thermal coherence cliff as a kind, not a number.
description: Tλ is not Tc(n).
notes: Downward from phase-space-condensate and chargeless-superflow. Same honesty as thermal-cliff audit.

observed_text: A ballistic 1D constriction gated at B = 0 (or with only an in-plane field) should still show 2e²/h steps or pinch-off. A perpendicular Landau ladder is not required for the staircase.
implied_text: Landauer-channel hardware is a saddle in a 2DEG reservoir, not a gapped 2D bulk. Demanding B to open the steps identifies this machine with edge-channel.
description: QPC steps persist with no perpendicular B.
notes: Atomic form of no-perpendicular-b-required. Complements predicted:edge-channel:qpc-is-not-this-edge.

observed_text: A Coulomb-blockaded island should show bias/gate diamonds with period e set by Ec, not a two-terminal staircase locked to n×2e²/h. Opening the island into a ballistic constriction (or closing a QPC into a small island) should switch the readout from one artifact to the other, not rename it.
implied_text: Charging is an N=1 energy-gate. 1D modes are a Landauer channel. Same small electron structure; different machine.
description: Charging diamonds are not Landauer steps.
notes: Downward from landauer-channel and energy-gate. Library already cross-cites; this row is the design commitment.

observed_text: In a 2DEG that can host both a cyclotron line and integer Hall plateaus, walking the microwave drive off ωc should kill the absorption line without moving RH off RK/ν. Walking B off a plateau should kill the flat RH without requiring the microwave line to be the collapse.
implied_text: Same eB/m combination; different output. CR is a clock-match absorption; QHE is a DC edge-channel plateau.
description: The cyclotron line is not the Hall plateau.
notes: Downward from edge-channel. Uses the existing CR ↔ QHE related-entry split.

observed_text: RQ = h/e² as the tunnel-resistance floor that keeps island N integer should not appear as a Hall plateau at RK/ν with Rxx→0. A blockaded island is not a metrological Hall bar.
implied_text: Same h/e² bricks. RQ is a charge-quantization floor; RK is an edge-channel output.
description: RQ is not a Hall quantum.
notes: Promotes coulomb-blockade:consistency_gap:rq-not-hall to a design commitment. Twin of predicted:photoelectric-threshold:not-the-plasma-edge.

observed_text: A 2.224 MeV photon on deuterium should unbind d → p+n and should not start a muon-catalyzed cycle: no ~100–150 dt fusions per stopped muon, and the yield should not die with τμ or α-sticking.
implied_text: Opposite arrow on the same two nucleons. The unbinding gate is a photon plus a deuteron; the fusion-direction gate needs a muon.
description: A photodisintegration photon is not a muon catalyst.
notes: Downward from energy-gate. Complements predicted:muon-catalyzed-fusion:muon-free-cell-is-null.

observed_text: A pyroelectric LiTaO3 + D cell with no muon source should still be able to emit 2.45 MeV D–D neutrons on a thermal ramp, and that burst should not collapse after 2.197 μs. The yield should track ΔT and D inventory, not stopped-muon number or sticking.
implied_text: Pyroelectric fusion is a polar-field beam gate. It is not the μCF cycle and not a muon-free substitute for that cycle.
description: Pyroelectric neutrons do not die with τμ.
notes: Downward from energy-gate. Distinguishes the two uncommon H gates. Bounds EM-LENR: a pulsed-coil hydride is neither machine.

observed_text: On a given island the charging energy Ec = e²/2C should not be required to equal the work function φ of the leads. Changing lead φ (or the photoelectric threshold of the same metal) should not be sold as moving the diamond period.
implied_text: One design, two gates. Ec is electrostatic; φ is a surface unbinding. Identifying them collapses the charging island into the photoelectric face.
description: Ec is not φ.
notes: Twin of predicted:photoelectric-threshold:not-the-plasma-edge

observed_text: A CEνNS target exposed to neutrinos well below the 1.8 MeV inverse-beta-decay threshold should still produce N² recoils while qR ≪ 1. The IBD channel staying shut is not this collapse.
implied_text: The operating window is the coherence condition, not a rest-mass or charged-current gate. A large rate step at 1.8 MeV on the same nucleus would be a different machine.
description: CEνNS does not turn on at the IBD threshold.
value_text: Eν < 1.8 MeV still CEνNS if qR≪1
notes: Same-sample commitment. Extracted rows already say there is no IBD gate; this row is the would-be observation.

observed_text: The recoilless fraction f of a crystalline host should collapse or vanish at Tm when Bragg order and the bound-host buffer are lost. A melt or liquid of the same nuclei should not show this resonance.
implied_text: No grid ⇒ no recoilless channel. Sibling of shear sound and crystal κ dying at the same Tm.
description: Mössbauer f does not survive melting.
notes: Third melt twin on oscillator-grid. File already names melt as a collapse; this row pins it to the shared grid-loss test.

observed_text: A pyroelectric D–D cell whose host is taken through its ferroelectric Tc (LiTaO3 ~890 K) should lose the accelerating potential and the 2.45 MeV neutron burst even if deuterium is still present.
implied_text: The polar latch writes the field. Above Tc the field engine is gone; the nuclear gate has nothing to open it.
description: Pyroelectric fusion dies with the polar host.
notes: Downward from polar-latch. Twin of piezoelectricity:failure_mode:ferroelectric-tc. Ordinary ramps stay far below this cliff.

observed_text: A pair of plates whose metal faces are already islanded or plasma-transparent in the visible — so that ordinary reflectivity has collapsed — should not produce a conducting-plate Casimir attraction of the 1/d^4 class at the same gap. Dielectric contrast if any is a different, weaker channel.
implied_text: The faces still need a screening population. Starve that buffer and the mode cutoff of this kind dies with the mirror.
description: Starved screening faces starve Casimir contrast.
notes: Extends coupled-screening-failure onto Casimir. Do not predict the π²ℏc/240 prefactor. Localized particle plasmons / patch charge are not this claim.
